name: io.github.abm9111/chamber
description: Cited Q&A over your own notes, plus drift detection when a cited source changes. Local-first CLI.

environmentVariables.description: Path to a Python interpreter with onnxruntime, used by the local embedder. Optional: defaults to python3 on PATH; without onnxruntime, semantic search degrades and Chamber says so.
environmentVariables.name: CHAMBER_PYTHON

environmentVariables.description: API key for the configured model endpoint. Only read when model.base is not a loopback address; a local endpoint needs no key.
environmentVariables.name: CHAMBER_API_KEY
